recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. No further core changes are needed for FHIR-30701; related extension removal/deprecation work should remain under the separate FHIR-30702/FHIR-30703 decisions and Extension Pack history.
issue_request: FHIR-30701 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked Vocab to clarify the expansion-processing-rule CodeSystem definitions for all-codes, ungrouped, and groups-only so implementers could distinguish all codes from ungrouped codes and understand the UI-expansion context.
initial_application: Commit ade907ca5b applied the three approved definition replacements as part of a vocab R5 batch. The semantic wording was applied, but the all-codes definition was committed as 'he expansion...' instead of 'The expansion...'. Later commits touching the file only adjusted metadata, OID/version information, formatting, and shareable-profile metadata, leaving the typo in place.
additional_context: The edited terminology source remains in current core build scope: source/fhir.ini keeps CodeSystem and ValueSet as active vocab-owned resources, and source/oids.ini registers both expansion-processing-rule canonicals. FHIR-30700 provides the related ValueSet/$expand excludeNotForUI clarification in active operation source. FHIR-30702 and FHIR-30703 later removed underspecified ValueSet hierarchy extensions from core, while the Extension Pack retains valueset-expand-rules only as retired/deprecated external content; those related decisions do not supersede the CodeSystem definition.
reconciliation: Changed source/valueset/codesystem-expansion-processing-rule.xml so the all-codes definition begins 'The expansion...' while leaving the approved substantive wording for all three expansion-processing-rule concepts unchanged.
source_changes: source/valueset/codesystem-expansion-processing-rule.xml: restored the missing leading 'T' in the all-codes definition.
